# Research

My research focuses on Bayesian time series, state-space models, longitudinal data,
and causal inference.

## Longitudinal surrogate evaluation

I am developing a state-space framework for evaluating jointly longitudinal
outcomes and surrogate markers. The project combines causal inference with
sequential state-space modeling and is accompanied by the **OnlineSurr** R package.

- [Preprint on arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.12882)
- [OnlineSurr on GitHub](https://github.com/silvaneojunior/OnlineSurr)

## Dynamic generalized linear models

My work on k-parametric dynamic generalized linear models develops sequential
Bayesian methods for state-space time-series models, including simulation-free
inference based on information-geometric ideas.

- [kDGLM on GitHub](https://github.com/silvaneojunior/kDGLM)
- [k-DGLM methodology preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.05387)
- [kDGLM package preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13069)

## Time-series mixture models

I am also working on sequential methods for mixture models in time-series settings.
